constitutional_core.amendment_rule: The constitutional core may change only after explicit user authorization. Ordinary task closeout may update current_state, bottleneck, evidence summary, priority ordering, and task history but may not silently alter core principles.
constitutional_core.mission: Build a spot-only, causal, adaptive cryptocurrency speculation system that compounds capital efficiently across materially different market regimes while preserving scientific validity, risk discipline, and generalization.

north_star.interpretation: Use 0.5% daily geometric growth as the top-level economic research objective and axis-prioritization criterion. It is not a promise and is not a mandatory pass gate for every diagnostic.

principles.rule: All work must serve the construction of a robust spot-only adaptive trading system, not isolated backtest wins.
Research priorities must be ranked by plausible and evidence-backed contribution toward the 0.5% daily geometric-growth north star, with risk and generalization constraints.
The bot must adapt materially to market regime and phase. Regime labels without meaningful changes in continuation, protection, exposure, or capital allocation do not satisfy the objective.
The exit brain must selectively kill failed theses and protect downside while preserving long-winner continuation; blanket early exits and inherited fixed holding ceilings require evidence.
Admission, sizing, occupancy, cash reuse, and slot allocation must be judged at portfolio level, including opportunity cost and downstream effects.
Runtime logic may use only information available at decision time. No lookahead, future outcomes, pair/event identity rules, post-hoc outcome thresholds, or hidden leakage.
No architecture may be accepted because it fits one asset, event, year, or market phase. Cross-period and cross-regime robustness are first-class requirements.
Growth is evaluated together with drawdown, turnover, costs, concentration, and risk-adjusted performance. Candidate-specific hard gates must be preregistered before execution.
Work one bottleneck at a time. Freeze the protocol and pass/fail criteria before candidate execution. Do not retune a failed candidate without a new explicitly justified protocol.
Certified bounds and locked causal tests outrank descriptive diagnostics; descriptive counterfactuals, hindsight witnesses, and concentrated anecdotes must never be promoted to causal runtime rules.
Any change to exits, occupancy, slot release, same-pair state, or capital reuse requires full lineage accounting of common/divergent trades and downstream admissions.
Consumed holdouts remain diagnostic only; sealed holdouts remain untouched until separately authorized by a preregistered protocol. Holdout status overrides convenience.
Research success never implies production authorization. Production change requires a separate explicit authorization and safety gate.
Every task must state how its result advances, preserves, blocks, or contradicts the overall vision and north star before the task may be accepted as complete.

Every task, including failed or blocked tasks, must update this charter through the mandatory closeout gate. No PASS or accepted completion is valid without a charter revision and committed alignment record.

A local improvement is not an architectural success if the axis lacks sufficient economic headroom or conflicts with stronger evidence. Exhausted axes move to backlog and require new evidence or authority before revival.
